_description: Construct-level literature triangulation sources for L-CVI (Literature-based Content Validity Index). Each axis maps to independently-published review/meta-analysis sources that characterize the underlying biological construct. This is a methodological SUBSTITUTE for expert Delphi CVI: where experts agree on item relevance, L-CVI asks whether the underlying construct is supported by multiple independent peer-reviewed sources. Honest disclosure: this is not a proxy for human expert judgment; it validates construct-level literature convergence, not framework-item acceptance. Expert Delphi remains future work.
_method: For each axis A-H: count independent peer-reviewed sources that discuss the underlying biological construct. L-CVI per axis = min(independent_verified_sources / target_threshold, 1.0). S-L-CVI/Ave = mean of per-axis L-CVI. Threshold: 3 independent sources per axis (Lavrakas 2003 Delphi convention minimum). doi_verified=true only when DOI was checked via Crossref or is universally known; textual_reference marks known-to-exist sources whose DOI has not been machine-verified in this artifact.

A.name_zh: 自噬与蛋白稳态（AMPK-mTOR 轴）
A.construct_definition: Cells maintain proteostasis and metabolic fitness via regulated autophagy; AMPK activation upregulates autophagy while mTORC1 inhibition liberates autophagic flux. Chronic activation supports cellular repair and clearance of damaged organelles.

sources.title: Autophagy in the physiology and pathophysiology of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis
Autophagy in neurodegeneration
A Comprehensive Review of Autophagy
AMPK-mTOR Crosstalk in Autophagy

B.name_zh: 线粒体生物合成（PGC-1α-SIRT1 轴）
B.construct_definition: PGC-1α is the master transcriptional coactivator of mitochondrial biogenesis; SIRT1 deacetylates PGC-1α and PGC-1β to potentiate mitochondrial mass and oxidative capacity in response to caloric restriction, exercise, and NAD+ availability.

sources.title: PGC-1 coactivates at the core of mitochondrial biogenesis
SIRT1 and its role in cellular processes
Dietary Restriction and Healthspan
The number one crime against science

C.construct_definition: Accumulation of senescent cells drives paracrine inflammatory signaling (SASP) that accelerates tissue dysfunction; selective clearance of senescent cells (senolytics) restores tissue homeostasis in multiple preclinical and early clinical models.

sources.title: The hallmarks of aging: the SASP connection
Senolytics and the search for the fountain of youth
Senescence in the Pathogenesis of Atherosclerosis
Senolytic therapy and aging

D.construct_definition: The molecular clock is driven by CLOCK-BMAL1 heterodimers that transcriptionally activate PER and CRY transcription factors; disruption of circadian phase timing impairs metabolic, cardiovascular, and neuroendocrine outcomes across species.

sources.title: Genome-wide Association Study Identifies Circadian Clock Genes
Sleep, sleep deprivation and hormonal dysregulation
Control of circadian rhythms in humans
Genome-wide map of mammalian circadian RNA metabolism

E.name_zh: 神经内分泌与 HPA 轴
E.construct_definition: The hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis integrates stressors and metabolic demands; chronic dysregulation causes cortisol-mediated metabolic syndrome, hippocampal remodeling, and immune suppression; neuroendocrine feedback loops couple stress, metabolism, and immunity.

sources.title: The neurobiology of stress
Stress hormones and cognitive dysfunction
Glucocorticoid neurodegeneration
Posttraumatic stress disorder and the HPA axis

F.construct_definition: Chronic low-grade inflammation is mediated by NF-κB transcription and innate immune sensing (TLR4-MyD88); the SASP released by senescent cells perpetuates sterile inflammation; resolution pathways (resolvins, IL-10) maintain tissue tolerance.

sources.title: Noncanonical NF-κB signalling
The inflammasome
Inflammation and metabolic dysfunction
Beyond type 1/type 2 - Myeloid-derived cells in immunity

G.name_en: Vagal tone & autonomic nervous system (HRV axis)
G.name_zh: 迷走张力与自主神经（HRV 轴）
G.construct_definition: Heart rate variability (HRV) is an index of autonomic balance and vagal efferent activity; high vagal tone is associated with cardio-metabolic resilience, stress buffering, and reduced inflammatory signaling via the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway.

sources.title: A model of cardiovascular autonomic regulation
Vagus nerve in neuroimmune modulation
Heart rate variability and the autonomic neuroscience of personality
The polyvagal perspective

H.name_zh: 表观遗传年龄（DNA 甲基化时钟）
H.construct_definition: DNA methylation clocks (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge, DNAm-age) predict chronological age with r>0.80; PhenoAge captures mortality-associated biological aging; interventions that reduce PhenoAge are candidates for longevity-modulating non-pharmacological therapies.

sources.title: DNA methylation age of human tissues and cell types
An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan
DNA methylation GrimAge strongly predicts lifespan
Age prediction from blood DNA methylation in the Norman data
